name: fluxmail-cloud
description: Search, read, draft, send and organize email across Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo, AOL, Fastmail and other IMAP mailboxes connected to Fluxmail Cloud.

interface.longDescription:
Fluxmail lets you search your work and personal email together in one ChatGPT conversation, catch up on a thread, and reply from the right address.

It works with Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook, Microsoft 365, iCloud Mail, Yahoo Mail, AOL, Fastmail, and any other provider that supports IMAP and SMTP.

Fluxmail also reads PDF attachments and organizes mail in bulk. You can review each draft before it’s sent.

You choose which mailboxes ChatGPT can access and what it can do with them, from reading to sending. A Fluxmail Cloud account is required.
defaultPrompt: Which emails across my work and personal inboxes still need a reply?
Find Dana Lee's latest email in any of my inboxes and draft a reply from the address it was sent to.
What's the total and due date on the latest invoice PDF in my email?

positive.description: Find mail that needs a reply across both mailboxes
positive.prompt: Which emails across my work and personal inboxes still need a reply?
positive.expected_behavior: Checks both fluxmailtest@gmail.com and fluxtest123@outlook.com and returns one combined answer that names the mailbox for each message. It flags "Dana Lee: can we meet Thursday?" in Gmail, and "Dana Lee: updated Northwind proposal for review" and "Re: Q4 budget review notes" in Outlook. It doesn't flag the flight confirmation or the Example Weekly newsletters. Nothing is sent or changed.

positive.description: Draft a reply from the mailbox that received the message
positive.prompt: Find Dana Lee's latest email in any of my inboxes and draft a reply from the address it was sent to.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches both mailboxes and finds that the latest Dana Lee email is "Dana Lee: updated Northwind proposal for review" in fluxtest123@outlook.com, which is newer than the Gmail message. It creates a reply draft in that thread in the Outlook mailbox, sent from fluxtest123@outlook.com, and confirms the draft was saved without sending it.

positive.prompt: Open the PDF in the "Invoice INV-1042 from Acme Supplies" email and tell me the total and the due date.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user allows ChatGPT to load the attachment, reads Acme-Supplies-INV-1042.pdf and reports a total due of $1,284.50 and a due date of November 15, 2026.

positive.prompt: From my Gmail account, send an email to fluxmailtest@gmail.com with the subject "Fluxmail review test" and the body "Testing the Fluxmail plugin."
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms the send, delivers the message from fluxmailtest@gmail.com to itself and reports that it was sent. The message appears in the mailbox's inbox and Sent mail.

positive.prompt: Add the label Newsletters to all the Example Weekly emails in my Gmail account.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the four Example Weekly emails (issues 41 to 44) and applies the Newsletters label, creating the label if it doesn't exist. It reports that the four messages are labeled. If an earlier run already labeled them, it says no change was needed.

negative.description: The connection doesn't allow permanent deletion, so the plugin shouldn't erase mail.
negative.prompt: Permanently delete every email in my inbox.

negative.description: The request is unrelated to email. The plugin can't book travel, so it should say so without changing any mail.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Denver next Friday.

negative.description: The plugin can only reach mailboxes the user connected and approved, so it should say it can't access another person's inbox.

review.commerce_description: This plugin doesn't sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Describes multi-account search, send checks and access controls more clearly. When a plan is inactive, ChatGPT now links to the Fluxmail Cloud dashboard instead of the billing page.
